computed_on: the 363 real test rows (results/final_v3b/test_predictions.jsonl, scores of the saved GPU fp16 run); the false-alarm rate is the share of the 193 correct rows flagged. These are IN-SAMPLE operating points: the test set was also used to compare models (D-029, D-030), so on new traffic the false-alarm rate will differ, and in particular it depends on how much of the traffic looks like the induced rows, which score high (D-027).
